title: IntentCompiler Output
description: Schema for the IntentCompiler response format. Every response must be a single JSON object conforming to this schema.

message.description: Conversational reply to the user. Plain text only — no markdown, no emojis, no exclamation marks.

quick_replies.description: 2-3 suggested replies the user can pick from to continue the conversation.

ready_to_build.description: True only when spec.confidence >= 80 and spec.open_questions is empty.

Spec.description: The extracted project specification. Only include fields that are new or changed in the current turn; the client merges incrementally.

project_type.description: Category of the project, e.g. landing-page, dashboard, e-commerce, portfolio.

features.description: Each feature as a short phrase. Only include NEW features not mentioned in prior turns.

tech_preferences.description: User-stated technology preferences. Only include NEW preferences not mentioned in prior turns.

constraints.description: Budget, timeline, accessibility, or other constraints. Only include NEW constraints not mentioned in prior turns.

open_questions.description: Questions that still need answers before the spec is complete.

confidence.description: How complete the spec is, from 0 (nothing understood) to 100 (fully specified).
